paper.title_en: Inverse Area Corrections to Black Hole Entropy Area Formula in F(R) Gravity and Gravitational Wave Observations
paper.abstract_en: We consider corrections to the Bekenstein Hawking Area Formula for black hole entropy, which have inverse powers of the horizon area for very large horizon areas, for classical spherically symmetric black hole solutions of F(R) modified gravity theory, using the Wald formula for the entropy function with modifications suggested by Jacobson, Kang and Myers. Requiring that the coefficient of such corrections be absolutely consistent with gravitational wave observational results validating the Hawking Area Theorem for binary black hole coalescences, implies constraints on parameters of F(R) gravity. For the sake of comparison, we present a computation of inverse area corrections for quantum black holes in quantum general relativity, using the It from Bit approach of Wheeler modified by some tenets of Loop Quantum Gravity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接研究黑洞熵的Bekenstein-Hawking面积公式修正，属于黑洞热力学核心议题；结合Wald熵函数与Jacobson-Kang-Myers修正，并利用引力波观测对Hawking面积定理的验证来约束F(R)引力参数，理论与观测联系明确，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: F(R)引力中黑洞熵面积公式的逆面积修正与引力波观测
decision.abstract_zh: 我们考虑对黑洞熵的Bekenstein-Hawking面积公式的修正，对于非常大的视界面积，这些修正包含视界面积的负幂次；研究对象是F(R)修正引力理论的经典球对称黑洞解，所用方法是Wald熵函数公式以及由Jacobson、Kang和Myers提出的修正。要求此类修正的系数与验证双黑洞并合中Hawking面积定理的引力波观测结果完全一致，这将对F(R)引力的参数施加约束。为了进行比较，我们使用Wheeler的“It from Bit”方法并加以圈量子引力的一些原理修正，给出了量子广义相对论中量子黑洞逆面积修正的计算。
